summary: Backend-only testing for new Freshdesk real-API path and exclude_patterns feature. Added 2 new test modules and ran the full pytest suite (31 tests): 30 passed, 1 failed. The single failure exposes a real bug in comparison._is_excluded: `fnmatch.fnmatch` lets `*` cross `/` boundaries, so pattern 'ssl/*.key' incorrectly excludes 'ssl/deep/site.key' (spec explicitly says it must not). All other spec requirements verified: (a) hosted preview backend runs with MOCK_KEY -> freshdesk.is_configured() == False, admin login + /me + demo/seed + dashboard + runs + incidents + async compare all still pass; (b) exclude_patterns end-to-end via POST/GET/PUT strips whitespace, drops empties, and round-trips ('*.log','ssl/*.key'; 'backup/','conf.d/local.conf'); (c) all other _is_excluded rules pass (star-log, exact path, directory prefix, unmatched, empty patterns, no patterns); (d) freshdesk.create_ticket real path (with monkeypatched env acme.freshdesk.com/realkey123 and mocked httpx.AsyncClient) POSTs to https://acme.freshdesk.com/api/v2/tickets with HTTP Basic auth (key,'X') and a JSON body containing subject/description/email/priority=3 (int)/status=2 (int), and returns {mock:False, ok:True, ticket_id:'12345', url:'https://acme.freshdesk.com/a/tickets/12345'}; (e) simulated 401 and simulated httpx.RequestError both return {mock:True, ok:False, error:<string>} — graceful fallback; (f) create_freshdesk_incident under MOCK_KEY stores incident with mocked=True and freshdesk_url of form https://yourcompany.freshdesk.com/a/tickets/FD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX. Env + module state restored via load_dotenv(override=True) + importlib.reload in teardown.

minor.issue: Uses fnmatch.fnmatch which treats '*' as matching path separators, so pattern 'ssl/*.key' also excludes 'ssl/deep/site.key' — contrary to the spec ('single level only'). Fix: use pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).match(pat) OR split on '/' and match each segment (like .gitignore semantics). Alternatively translate the pattern with a regex that forbids '/' inside '*'.

action_items: Fix comparison._is_excluded so glob '*' does NOT cross '/' (e.g., use PurePosixPath.match or a segment-aware matcher). Current fnmatch-based implementation over-excludes: 'ssl/*.key' matches 'ssl/deep/site.key'.
critical_code_review_comments: comparison._is_excluded: fnmatch semantics are wrong for path globs — '*' should stop at '/'. Suggest: `PurePosixPath(path).match(pat)` for glob-style, plus keep the existing exact-match and directory-prefix branches.
freshdesk.create_ticket: good graceful degradation (retries on 429/5xx, mock fallback with error string). Consider setting a User-Agent header and logging ticket_id on success for auditability.
server.NodePairInput/Update.exclude_patterns: stripping empties in both create + update paths is correct; consider also de-duplicating patterns.

freshdesk.is_configured lowercases input for the placeholder check — good; PLACEHOLDER_DOMAINS covers 'yourcompany.freshdesk.com' and 'demo.freshdesk.com' which correctly keeps hosted preview in mock mode.

Currently fnmatch returns True so the assertion fails. When main agent switches _is_excluded to glob-aware matching (e.g., PurePosixPath.match), this test should pass. All hosted preview APIs green under MOCK_KEY.
rca of the issue: Python's fnmatch.fnmatch treats '*' as 'any characters including /'. Implementation calls fnmatch.fnmatch(full_path, pattern) OR fnmatch.fnmatch(basename, pattern). For pattern 'ssl/*.key' and path 'ssl/deep/site.key', fnmatch matches because '*' consumes 'deep/site'. Expected glob semantics (per spec and .gitignore-style) require '*' to match within a single path segment only. Reproduction: `python -c "import fnmatch; print(fnmatch.fnmatch('ssl/deep/site.key','ssl/*.key'))"` prints True. Mitigation: replace fnmatch call with `pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).match(pat)` (which honors segment boundaries) while retaining the existing basename-only and directory-prefix branches for backwards compatibility.
